channel.title: Pier & Point · P9
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for P9 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · P9: The Rec and Park page gives an estimated schedule of construction beginning late…
item.description: The Rec and Park page gives an estimated schedule of construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030; its background text says the remaining parks are anticipated to be complete by 2028. These are expected dates, not events. Source: https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project.

item.title: Correction · P9: The timeline now shows the Future Parks construction start as expected in 2028…
item.description: The timeline now shows the Future Parks construction start as expected in 2028 and the opening as expected in 2030, both from the schedule table on Rec and Park's project page. The same page also says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028', so the sources disagree and no month is shown. Source: Rec and Park, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project).

item.title: Milestone · P9: Rec and Park's October 2026 update says the developer is surveying the… (Oct 2026)

item.title: Correction · P9: The notes said no named, funded project had been found for P9
item.description: The notes said no named, funded project had been found for P9. SF Rec & Park's Mission Bay Future Parks Project page names P7 and P9 as future active-recreation parks (skate park, pickleball courts, ballfield) fully funded through OCII, with construction to begin in late 2028, so that caveat was replaced and the page is now cited for the planned status and park use. The 'construction staging materials' description is now labelled an imagery observation, and an out-of-date note saying the neighbouring P8 record had been removed was corrected. Source: SF Recreation and Park Department, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project).
item.source: SF Recreation and Park Department, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project)

item.title: Milestone · P9: Design-team selection process under way: per Rec and Park's August 2025… (Aug 2025)
item.description: Design-team selection process under way: per Rec and Park's August 2025 update, the developer (Mission Bay Development Group) released a request for qualifications in early August 2025 and expected to select a design team by mid-October (Aug 2025). Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (News Flash), 2025-08-26.
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (News Flash), 2025-08-26

item.title: Planned · P9: Same Dec 2015 LRPMP lists Park P9 (APN 8709-002, south of Mission Bay… (Dec 2015)
item.description: Same Dec 2015 LRPMP lists Park P9 (APN 8709-002, south of Mission Bay Drive under I-280) as a designated Open Space Park Parcel under the 1998 OPA (Dec 2015). Source: Mission Bay North and South Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan, Dec 2015.
